side: FRONT = the COMPONENT side (Apple's FCC caption). O'Flynn's backside-fullres.jpeg IS this side.

frame.origin: board centre, transferred from FCC photo 6 through c_register's homography; the transferred OUTER outline lands on this board's edge all the way round (evidence/E-L1-transferred-frame-on-oflynn-front.png) and no outline point was fitted to
frame.axes: +x right, +y DOWN (image convention); theta from +x through +y

scale.basis: metrology/M02 m_scale_at photo6 at the board (952,678), two routes 0.23% apart
scale.decoration_factor: 3.9-5.1x more stored pixels than resolved detail (M06)
scale.independent_check: the nRF52832 body measures -0.23% / -0.54% against its datasheet at this scale (M08)

uncertainty.note: DO NOT QUOTE ANY POSITION TO 0.01 mm. The floor is 2-3 genuine px.

excluded.what: neutral-black IC packages, including the large one at 9 o'clock
excluded.why: B-R = +0.5 against a board median of +1, so colour cannot see them; dark+smooth merges with bare soldermask; a black top-hat connects the board into one 1.76 Mpx blob; and a stated ROI with Otsu inside returns the BOX (0/20/40/60 px padding gives 3.35/3.98/4.09/4.50 mm for the same part). See M08 Sec 2.
excluded.instruction: DO NOT place these by hand from the transferred frame. An eyeballed position in a file of measured ones is the contamination this lane exists to prevent.

excluded.why: two photographs fail to pin it in DIFFERENT directions (M02 Sec 4, M07 Sec 5). Publish no hole diameter.
M03/M05. Do not draw the withdrawn 15 or 13 candidate angles as pads.

known_gaps.what: two gold-ringed round parts on the right of the board
known_gaps.found_how: BY LOOKING at a native-resolution tile (M09), not by any detector
known_gaps.why_missed: their bright ring is annular, so the bright-metal segmentation finds no filled blob of component size, and they are not blue so the colour detector cannot see them either
known_gaps.note: EYEBALLED off a tile to about a millimetre. Present so the board is KNOWINGLY incomplete rather than looking complete. A miss written down is a different object from a miss not written down.

known_gaps.what: the large silver clip / contact beside the centre hole
known_gaps.found_how: BY LOOKING at a native-resolution tile (M09)
known_gaps.why_missed: it abuts the hole's bright region and is absorbed into it by the flood fill, so it is masked out before segmentation runs

known_gaps.found_how: absence confirmed by eye at native resolution (M09)
known_gaps.why_missed: see `excluded`: neutral-black packages are CANNOT DETERMINE
